blurb: Guests can visit the flagship taproom in West Midtown Atlanta to enjoy craft beers, outdoor patio seating, a turfed beer garden, and a small dog park. The brewery offers small bites and occasional food trucks. They also provide merchandise and distribute their beers throughout Georgia and nearby states.
